title: Shell Island Excursions

services.name: Sunset Tours
services.desc: We offer Panama City Beach Sunset Cruises in addition to dolphin tours and adventure trips. We can accommodate parties of up to 6 guests on each of our boats. On these 2 or 3 hour trips, we can find plenty of resident dolphins, visit shell islands peace full beaches after the crowds have gone in and head back to the gulf for an unobstructed view of the sun setting into the Gulf of America!. Although we don’t usually get into snorkeling on sunset cruises, we always see dolphins playing, and if we stop to enjoy the islands quiet beaches after the crowds are gone the kids can splash in the water to look for starfish or explore the shoreline looking for shells.. Departure times vary seasonally
